title: "Loading Please wait" instead of a false empty-folder message
description:
When you click into a job or open a folder, the file list used to briefly say "This folder is empty" before the files finished loading, which was confusing on folders that actually had contents.

Now the list shows "Loading Please wait" while it fetches, and only shows the empty-folder message (with the New folder / Create project structure hint) once loading finishes and there really is nothing there.

Who is affected: everyone using the PipeShare file explorer on the private server, and on SaaS after Push.
changeLog: File explorer shows "Loading Please wait" while a folder's contents load.
The "This folder is empty" hint now only appears after loading finishes and the folder is truly empty.
Fixes the false empty-folder flash when first opening a job or navigating into a folder.
